steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Pericles dominated Athenian politics for over 30 years (c. 461-429 BC), elected strategos repeatedly | Key Fact: The Athenian building programme: Parthenon, Propylaea, Erechtheion on the Acropolis, funded by Delian League tribute | Key Fact: Pericles' Funeral Oration (431 BC, recorded by Thucydides) celebrated Athenian democracy, freedom and cultural superiority | Key Fact: The Peloponnesian War (431-404 BC) between Athens and Sparta devastated Greece and ended the Athenian Golden Age
